title: Independent audit: exact rational shear-orbit interval oracle
body:
An independent interval-feasibility oracle agrees with 2,268 complete rational windows, 1,001 half-grid horizons and a large-offset sharp witness. It corroborates PR1631’s K=70 radius of 18.

This is a deliberately independent audit of [PR1631](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1631) at 1c8878b702ee74d21f8a17737c44c6474143cedd. The precise mathematical domain, separately implemented method, failure controls, exact source pins, predecessor credit and open next question are in research/shear-orbit-interval-audit/README.md. The predecessor result is credited; no defect or new original theorem is implied.

Validation: Python3.12 registered replay and metadata/source checks pass; Python3.14 optimized replay produces the identical exact receipt; modified source and receipt controls reject; selected-record integrity and whitespace checks pass. No full cold/native/hosting/all-size replay or new kappa is claimed. Only this new package changes.

Reproduce: python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/shear-orbit-interval-audit.
